en.title: Bitcoin and Ether Rally as Short Squeeze Hits Bears

Treasury intervention and regulatory clarity boosted market confidence
Banks and tech firms increased stablecoin adoption for payments
Elon Musk's X platform plans to pay creators using stablecoins
en.caption:

Regulatory clarity and Treasury intervention supported the upward move.
Banks and tech firms expanded stablecoin use while X platform plans creator payments in stablecoins.
